headline: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
summary: Congress plans to tighten export rules for AI chips. This follows a scandal involving Nvidia's ex-CEO and a suspected Chinese spy. Both parties demand Nvidia leaders testify before Congress.

headline: Fanttik’s S1 Pro electric screwdriver is $40 off in the run-up to Black Friday
summary: The Fanttik S1 Pro electric screwdriver is $40 off. It's currently priced at an all-time low of $39.99 on Amazon. This is an early Black Friday deal available for a limited time.

headline: Apple’s first smart glasses are coming together
summary: Apple's first smart glasses are reportedly in development. They will initially lack augmented reality features. An announcement is expected at WWDC next June, with shipments later in the year.

headline: Rachelle Hampton won’t admit how long she spent charting the use of ‘murmur’ in Twilight
summary: Rachelle Hampton is a writer and co-owner at Defector Media. She hosts the popular podcast 'Normal Gossip.' The article humorously highlights her deep dive into 'Twilight' word usage.

headline: EA Adds 'Don't Delete' Message to Madden NFL 27 in Bid to Keep Players From Making Room Ahead of GTA 6
summary: EA has added a 'don't delete' pop-up to Madden NFL 27. Players see it as a plea to retain their game. It's believed to be an attempt to prevent players from making space for GTA 6.

headline: Xbox at 25: My Memories From Across Xbox’s Entire (and Quite Incredible) History
summary: An IGN writer reflects on Xbox's 25-year history. The article covers the console's highs and lows since 2001. The author shares personal memories, starting with Halo's launch.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Asus TUF Gaming Laptop, Saros, 4K Blu-ray Sale, and More
summary: Discover today's best tech and gaming deals. Featured offers include an Asus TUF Gaming Laptop. There's also a significant 4K Blu-ray sale and other product discounts.

headline: GTA 6 Leak Seemingly Reveals Official Album's Full Track List Days Before Launch
summary: The full tracklist for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album has reportedly leaked. This reveal comes just days before GTA 6's official launch. Fans now have an early look at the game's music.

headline: Staggered age of consent to be discussed after Brand case, minister says
summary: A staggered age of consent system will be discussed by ministers. This follows allegations against jailed comedian Russell Brand. A victim campaigns to criminalize relationships between 16-17 year olds and adults.

headline: Man and woman die and four arrested after police pursuit crash in Leeds
summary: Two people died in a police pursuit crash in Leeds. Four individuals were subsequently arrested. Arrests were made on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving.

headline: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky urges the US and Elon Musk to lift Starlink restrictions. He states current restrictions hinder efforts against Russian attacks. Zelensky calls on them to be on the 'right side of history'.

headline: Ex-Met Police inspector lied about wife's death in Barbados hotel room, BBC learns
summary: A former Met Police inspector reportedly lied about his wife's death. His wife was found in a blood-stained Barbados hotel room. The inspector previously faced claims of exploiting crime victims.
